headlines.title_he: מחלוקת ב-NEET: שר החינוך ההודי דרמנדרה פרדהאן מתפטר על רקע מחאות ה-CJP
headlines.snippet_he: שר החינוך של הודו, דרמנדרה פרדהאן, התפטר בעקבות מחאות ה-CJP הקשורות למחלוקת NEET. על כך דווח על ידי Gulf News.

headlines.title: UAE travel alert: US, UK, Canada, Australia renew warnings for Middle East as Etihad, Qatar Airways update flights
headlines.snippet: The UAE, alongside the US, UK, Canada, and Australia, has renewed travel warnings for the Middle East. Etihad and Qatar Airways are updating flight services.

headlines.title: UAE, Saudi Arabia and allies condemn Israeli actions at Al Aqsa Mosque
headlines.snippet: The UAE, Saudi Arabia, and allied nations have condemned Israeli actions at the Al-Aqsa Mosque. The condemnation expresses strong disapproval of the events.
headlines.title_he: איחוד האמירויות, ערב הסעודית ובעלות בריתה מגנים את פעולות ישראל במסגד אל-אקצא
headlines.snippet_he: איחוד האמירויות, ערב הסעודית ובעלות בריתיהן גינו את פעולות ישראל במסגד אל-אקצא. גינוי זה דווח על ידי Gulf News.

headlines.snippet: Mardawi described the burning of two mosques in the West Bank by settlers as a systematic fascist crime. This statement condemns the violent acts.

headlines.snippet: The city of Sana'a declares itself free and will not accept any part of Yemen being occupied. This statement asserts national sovereignty.

headlines.snippet: The equation of deterrence and breaking the siege.

headlines.snippet: The governor of Lahj praised the 'Jizan and Yanbu' operations and condemned the Saudi aggression against Hodeidah. The statement supports military actions and denounces attacks.

headlines.snippet: President Al-Mashat affirmed that the armed forces' actions are legitimate and just according to religious, humanitarian, and moral principles.

headlines.title: Iran says progress made in talks with Oman on Hormuz shipping mechanisms
headlines.snippet: Iran reported progress in talks with Oman regarding shipping mechanisms in the Strait of Hormuz. Discussions focused on operational arrangements for safe navigation.
headlines.snippet_he: איראן דיווחה על התקדמות בשיחות עם עומאן בנוגע למנגנוני שיט למצר הורמוז. ההתייעצויות התמקדו בהסדרים מבצעיים לניווט בטוח דרך נתיב המים האסטרטגי.

headlines.title: Israeli occupiers set fire to 2 mosques in occupied West Bank
headlines.snippet: Israeli occupiers set fire to two mosques in the occupied West Bank. Attacks targeted a mosque in Tulkarem and another under construction near Nablus.
headlines.snippet_he: כובשים ישראלים הציתו שני מסגדים בגדה המערבית הכבושה. הפיגועים כוונו למסגד בכפר טולכרם ולמסגד נוסף בבנייה ליד שכם.

headlines.title: Oil tanker explodes in Strait of Hormuz after hitting naval mine: Iranian media
headlines.snippet: An oil tanker exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine, according to Iranian media. The vessel had reportedly deviated from its designated navigation route.

headlines.title: Over 700,000 evacuated as Typhoon Noul makes landfall in southern China
headlines.snippet: Over 700,000 people have been evacuated as Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China. The typhoon, the strongest this year, also caused flight cancellations.

headlines.title: Syria has ‘moment of opportunity’ to build ‘prosperous future,’ Sednaya shows brutality of Assad’s regime: UN chief
headlines.snippet: UN Chief Guterres stated Syria has an 'opportunity' to build a prosperous future, while noting the brutality of the Assad regime exemplified by Sednaya prison.

headlines.title: Parliament convenes for student amnesty, terror-free Türkiye
headlines.snippet: The Turkish Parliament will convene to discuss student amnesty and the 'terror-free Türkiye' initiative. These legislative matters are central to the new session.

headlines.title: Turkish F-16 fighter jets gear up for key Baltic mission
headlines.snippet: Five Turkish F-16 fighter jets and 76 crew members are preparing for a key mission in Estonia. The deployment is part of NATO's air policing operations.

headlines.title: Syria sees Israeli incursion day after UN chief urges no violations
headlines.snippet: Syrian state media reported an Israeli incursion into southern Syria on Sunday, one day after the UN chief urged an end to such violations.

headlines.title: Israeli settlers vandalize, torch 2 mosques in occupied West Bank
headlines.snippet: Israeli settlers vandalized and set fire to at least two mosques in the occupied West Bank on Sunday. Palestinian officials condemned the escalation of violence.

headlines.title: EU eyes say in Cyprus while ignoring Turkish Cypriots
headlines.snippet: The EU's focus on Cyprus appears to disregard Turkish Cypriots, even as the UN restarts efforts to resolve the Cyprus question. This raises concerns about inclusivity.

headlines.title: PHOTO Best restaurants in Istanbul, ranked
headlines.snippet: The Hürriyet newspaper's jury of experts has compiled a guide ranking Istanbul's best restaurants. The guide features the top 20 establishments.

headlines.title: Top 29 must-try Turkish street foods Türkiye is frequently described as a paradise when it comes to cuisine.
headlines.snippet: Turkey is celebrated for its cuisine, including a wide array of street foods. The article highlights 29 must-try Turkish street foods, from 'wet' burgers to roasted chestnuts.

headlines.title: Top 20 museums in Türkiye As a historic home to great civilizations, Türkiye has some of the world’s best museums.
headlines.snippet: Türkiye, a historical home to civilizations like the Roman and Ottoman empires, boasts some of the world's best museums. The list includes the top 20 museums.
